definitions: A large Roman villa in the village of Fishbourne, West Sussex, England, known for its extensive and well-preserved mosaics.
The remains of a Roman palatial residence, believed to have been built for Tiberius Claudius Cogidubnus, a local client king of the Romans.
examples: The mosaics at Fishbourne Palace are world-renowned.
Archaeologists continue to uncover new sections of Fishbourne Palace.
Visitors can explore the reconstructed gardens of Fishbourne Palace.
